title: assure
description: Starts the assure command line: reads the subcommand and its flags, runs assure record (ST-ASR-CMD01-CLI, through ST-ASR-CH01), assure gate change (ST-ASR-CMD02-CLI) or assure gate release (ST-ASR-CMD03-CLI, both through ST-ASR-CH02), or assure ledger (ST-ASR-QRY01-CLI, through ST-ASR-CH03), and exits with its code: 0 when it did its work or the commit passed, 1 when it refused, record failed or a proof did not pass at the commit, 2 when it was called wrongly, the gate cannot decide or the ledger cannot be built.
